map.预算 5000、CPC 2 元 → 点击 2500；CTR 2% → 展示 25: Budget 5000 at a CPC of 2 CNY gives 2500 clicks; CTR 2% gives impressions 2500/0.02 = 125000; CPM = 5000/(125000/1000) = 40 CNY; with a target of 100 conversions, CPA = 50 CNY.
map.预算 5000、CPM 40 元 → 展示 125000；CTR 2% → 点击: Budget 5000 at a CPM of 40 CNY gives 125000 impressions; CTR 2% gives 2500 clicks, so CPC = 5000/2500 = 2 CNY; 100 conversions gives CPA = 50 CNY. Unit prices match under both buying methods.
map.CPC 和 CPM 怎么选？: How to choose between CPC and CPM?
map.追求点击/转化选 CPC，按效果付费更稳；做品牌曝光选 CPM，按展示量买量更便: Choose CPC when chasing clicks or conversions, since paying for outcomes is safer; choose CPM for brand exposure, where buying by impression is cheaper.
map.CTR 太低说明什么？: What does a very low CTR mean?
map.CTR 低通常是素材或定向问题，先优化创意和人群，再调出价，否则高 CPM 也换: A low CTR usually points to creative or targeting problems; fix the creative and audience before raising bids, otherwise even a high CPM buys no useful clicks.
